commands.name: aspire
commands.description: Commands related to Aspire project scaffolding

commands.name: caching
commands.description:
Modify Aspire project to make it caching ready.

Examples:
  Add Redis distributed caching to an Aspire web project:
    dotnet scaffold aspire caching --type redis --apphost-project C:/MyApp/MyApp.AppHost/MyApp.AppHost.csproj --project C:/MyApp/MyApp.Web/MyApp.Web.csproj

  Add Redis with output caching using prerelease packages:
    dotnet scaffold aspire caching --type redis-with-output-caching --apphost-project C:/MyApp/AppHost.csproj --project C:/MyApp/WebApi.csproj --prerelease

options.name: --type
options.description: The type of caching to add. Only 'redis' (for distributed caching) and 'redis-with-output-caching' (for response caching) are available.

options.name: --apphost-project
options.description: Absolute path to the Aspire App host project file (.csproj) that orchestrates your distributed application.

options.name: --project
options.description: Absolute path to the web or worker project file (.csproj) to be modified. This project should be referenced by the App host.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include prerelease package versions when installing Aspire components. Useful for testing preview features. [default: False]

commands.name: database
commands.description:
Modify Aspire project to make it database ready.

Examples:
  Add SQL Server with Entity Framework Core to an Aspire API project:
    dotnet scaffold aspire database --type sqlserver-efcore --apphost-project C:/MyApp/MyApp.AppHost/MyApp.AppHost.csproj --project C:/MyApp/MyApp.Api/MyApp.Api.csproj

  Add PostgreSQL with Entity Framework Core:
    dotnet scaffold aspire database --type npgsql-efcore --apphost-project C:/MyApp/AppHost.csproj --project C:/MyApp/WebApp.csproj

options.name: --type
options.description: The type of database to add. Use 'npgsql-efcore' for PostgreSQL with EF Core or 'sqlserver-efcore' for SQL Server with EF Core.

options.name: --apphost-project
options.description: Absolute path to the Aspire App host project file (.csproj) that orchestrates your distributed application.

options.name: --project
options.description: Absolute path to the web or worker project file (.csproj) to be modified. This project should be referenced by the App host.

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include prerelease package versions when installing Aspire components. Useful for testing preview features. [default: False]

commands.name: storage
commands.description:
Modify Aspire project to make it storage ready.

Examples:
  Add Azure Blob Storage to an Aspire worker project:
    dotnet scaffold aspire storage --type azure-storage-blobs --apphost-project C:/MyApp/MyApp.AppHost/MyApp.AppHost.csproj --project C:/MyApp/MyApp.Worker/MyApp.Worker.csproj

  Add Azure Storage Queues for message processing:
    dotnet scaffold aspire storage --type azure-storage-queues --apphost-project C:/MyApp/AppHost.csproj --project C:/MyApp/MessageProcessor.csproj

options.name: --type
options.description: The type of Azure storage to add. Options: 'azure-storage-queues' for queue messaging, 'azure-storage-blobs' for blob storage, or 'azure-data-tables' for table storage.

options.name: --apphost-project
options.description: Absolute path to the Aspire App host project file (.csproj) that orchestrates your distributed application.

commands.name: apicontroller-crud
commands.description:
Create an API controller with REST actions to create, read, update, delete, and list entities

Examples:
  Generate API controller with full CRUD operations:
    dotnet scaffold aspnet apicontroller-crud --project C:/MyApiApp/MyApiApp.csproj --model Product --controller-name ProductsController --data-context AppDbContext --database-provider SqlServer

  Generate controller with PostgreSQL using prerelease packages:
    dotnet scaffold aspnet apicontroller-crud --project C:/MyApi/MyApi.csproj --model Customer --controller-name CustomersController --data-context ShopContext --database-provider PostgreSQL --prerelease

commands.name: minimalapi
commands.description:
Generates an endpoints file (with CRUD API endpoints) given a model and optional DbContext.

Examples:
  Generate minimal API endpoints with OpenAPI support:
    dotnet scaffold aspnet minimalapi --project C:/MyApiApp/MyApiApp.csproj --model Product --endpoints-class ProductEndpoints --data-context AppDbContext --database-provider SqlServer --openapi

  Generate endpoints with TypedResults and OpenAPI:
    dotnet scaffold aspnet minimalapi --project C:/MyApi/MyApi.csproj --model Order --endpoints-class OrderApi --typed-results --openapi

commands.description:
Add Entra auth

Examples:
  Add Microsoft Entra ID authentication using an existing Azure application:
    dotnet scaffold aspnet entra-id --project C:/MyWebApp/MyWebApp.csproj --tenant-id your-tenant-id --use-existing-application true --application-id your-app-id

  Add Microsoft Entra ID authentication by creating a new Azure application:
    dotnet scaffold aspnet entra-id --project C:/MyWebApp/MyWebApp.csproj --tenant-id your-tenant-id --use-existing-application false
